extracted.name: Peanut Sauce
extracted.description: If you’ve never made Peanut Sauce from scratch, prepare to be amazed! It’s quick, easy, and packed with creamy, nutty goodness. Use it as a dip, dressing, or marinade.
ingredient_lines: 1/4 cup low-sodium soy sauce (, or tamari (60mL))
2 Tablespoons chili oil* ((30mL), for mild or add more for extra heat)
instruction_lines: Whisk together all ingredients until smooth (or use a food processor).
Uses: Dip for fresh spring rolls, crispy air fryer tofu or veggies. Drizzle sauce over Asian chicken salad, spring roll bowls, poke bowls, yum yum bowls or coating for peanut noodles.
categories: peanut sauce recipe for spring rolls
